notes.title: Boyfriend Dungeon Patch Notes (Version: 1.3.7290)
notes.content:
Hello Sword-Smoochers!

We have a patch that addresses some of the smaller bugs from the Secret Weapons update including some localization errors that prevented non-English speakers from earning achievements.

Version: 1.3.7290:

[*] The final boss fight now has a new, fully-voiced conversation between your weapon and the antagonist, before the final phase.

[*] Jonah, Leah, and Rowan’s birthday gifts will now all show in the apartment.

[*] All shops should now always function in all languages, finally allowing non-English speakers to collect all outfits.

[*] Hammer’s final date will now make much more sense in German and Portuguese.    

[*] Various small fixes to dialogue and localization.

In cased you missed it, our last patch fixed the progression issues with Hammer. Please continue to report any bugs or issues on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/674930/discussions/0/4758602630159870998/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Known Issues thread[/url]!

-Alexandra and the Kitfox Crew!

notes.title: Secret Weapons is out NOW!
notes.content:
Attention Sword Smoochers!

We are happy to announce that the Boyfriend Dungeon Secret Weapons update is officially out NOW! To those returning to Verona Beach or visiting for the first time: Welcome! Axe, Hammer, Whip and the new Verona College dunj and more await you.

[previewyoutube=YSvq6hL5s4Q;full][/previewyoutube]

This is a free update and no additional purchase is required to play if you already own Boyfriend Dungeon. You will be able to play the update from your existing save files, but if you wanted to start fresh that's okay too. 

Here is the full changelog:

[b]NEW[/b]
[list]
[*]Midway through the nightclub dungeon (“La Rosa”), you will receive a text message. Responding to this message can lead you to new characters, weapons, a dungeon, dates, recipes, and more.
[*]To experience this content in an old save file, visit any dungeon or date, and then return to the apartment. You should receive the text message above, from someone named ‘S’.
[*]While exploring Verona Beach (the map “hub” screen), you may find 15 new “encounters” between weapons you’ve befriended.
[*]After receiving a birthday gift from a weapon, you will now see the gift appear in your apartment.
[*]Seven new achievements related to the new content have been added.
[*]This new content is equally compatible with old save files, or with newly started games.
[/list]

[b]BUGFIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]When you die in the dungeon, your weapon will now comment, including voice acting.
[*]When you start a dungeon run, your weapon’s comment voice acting audio will now follow you, as intended.
[*]All of Isaac/Estoc’s comments when starting a new dungeon run now have voice acting.
[*]Various typos and mistakes were fixed in the date text.
[/list]

[b]OTHER[/b]
[list]
[*]To account for the new content, the latter half of the nightclub dungeon (“La Rosa”) may have changed slightly.
[*]The game’s credits now include any new staff members and/or updated titles.
[*]Old “collect them all” achievement requirements have been updated to reflect the new content.
[/list]

Want to talk about the update with other wielders? Have any questions? Join our community of sword-smoochers on our socials:

[b][url=https://discord.com/invite/kitfoxgames]Discord[/url][/b]

[b][url=https://twitter.com/KitfoxGames]Twitter[/url][/b]

[b][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@kitfoxgames]Tiktok[/url][/b]

notes.title: Secret Weapons: New dunj + new outfits
notes.content:
Hello Sword-Smoochers!

It's Alexandra here! We are getting closer to the release of the Secret Weapons Update! The team is working hard at squashing bugs and making the weapon shiny enough for your wielder hands. First, let's talk new dunj:

[h2]Verona College Dunj[/h2]

You might remember Verona College from Boyfriend Dungeon as the school which Sawyer and Olivia take classes. Now it's a full-blown dunj teeming of new monsters, new hangouts and a new fear to conquer! What is it? We can't say, but you might be able to guess based on what you see!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/8baf43afdf896bad753359c0299c1f0715b4aa13.png[/img]

We've also added in some new features that you haven't experienced in the other dunjs. You might have seen the Whip boss fight teased in our [url=https://youtu.be/3GJg8bDyWp8]latest trailer[/url]. Along with some one-on-one time Whip, you'll also encounter special hangouts in the classrooms. Finally, we've included teleporters to some rooms which will be sure to offer a unique challenge when fighting in the dunj.

[h2]New Outfits![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/45f5c9092fa09c0339d35bf2b81dbf2de84749ac.gif[/img]

It wouldn't be a Boyfriend Dungeon update without some new clothes to try on in your apartment! We're adding new hats with special abilities in the dunj (that alien creature on your head seems menacing). And look at that cute cowboy look! You'll be able to find recipes for all the new outfits in the Verona Beach dunj.

[h2]Hammer or Axe? You decide![/h2]

We don't want to give everything away, but we would like to reveal one of the new transformation sequences ahead of launch. And we are putting it to a vote!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/e6c78085d6630b5441b647e70fc1477a9cae4ab4.png[/img]

Have your say on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/kitfoxgames]Kitfox Discord[/url]; there is an active poll in #announcements. We will post the winner's transformation video in the next update.

That's all for now and you'll hear from me again soon!

Alexandra

notes.title: Meet Dr. Holmes the Whip
notes.content:
Hey Sword-Smoochers!

It's almost time to catch your flight back to Verona Beach! We just announced Boyfriend Dungeon Secret Weapons update on Future of Play Direct coming free to all this summer for PC, Xbox and Switch! Reunite with the surfer softie Jonah the Axe and spin to win with Leah the Hammer in an all-new dunj. Watch the trailer now:

[previewyoutube=3GJg8bDyWp8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Meet Dr. Holmes the Whip[/h2]

We are honored to introduce a new romanceable weapon, Dr. Holmes the Whip! They are a special villain-weapon designed by CEO and Creative Director at Unseen Inc. and former Ghostwire Tokyo director [url=https://twitter.com/nakamura193?s=20&t=ezb0tvVutu-WUZDUyWrQ4Q]Ikumi Nakamura[/url]. We hinted at Dr. Holmes in a [url=https://www.kitfoxgames.com/en/boyfriend-dungeon-newsletter]secret love letter[/url] a few months ago. Some of you were quick to guess some of the clues too! You will encounter them as the boss of the new dunj but they will never accept a wielder. Will you be able to melt her cold heart? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/e4bedd0a5deb29deff9e1036a72e1f9e34f272b2.png[/img]

Dr. Holmes will be voiced by popular content creator and streamer, [url=https://twitter.com/Loserfruit?s=20&t=ezb0tvVutu-WUZDUyWrQ4Q]Kathleen 'Loserfruit' Belsten[/url], who you might know from the Fortnite Icon Series! We can't wait for you to meet them!

[h2]Whipped Into Shape[/h2]

Marskye and McQueen have been back in the studio putting together three new certified bops for the update and we played one of them in the trailer. You can listen to the full track, Whipped Into Shape right now on [url=https://soundcloud.com/marskye/whipped-into-shape/s-qbuFfFIGL2R?utm_source=clipboard&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=social_sharing]Marskye's Soundcloud[/url]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/04291ce954e40aebfd3a54ba6f8057a7d7849260.png[/img]


Keep your eyes peeled and join us in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/kitfoxgames]Kitfox Discord[/url] because we have been holding on to more surprises planned for the Secret Weapons Update!

P.S keep an eye out for a letter from the good Doctor in the coming weeks! They are very busy but also want to make sure you understand a few things...

-Alexandra + Tanya + Kitfox

notes.title: Hammer and Axe swing into action + A New Song!
notes.content:
Hey Sword-Smoochers!

It's May and we are getting to the point in DLC development where we have more to show you! We have a few goodies to share here and WAY more reveals coming soon. You might want to tune into The Future of Play Direct, a show happening before Summer Games Fest ... just a suggestion, if you're the kind of person that likes smooching weapons... >_>

[h2]Hammer and Axe Abilities[/h2]

Here are some work-in-progress gifs of the new weapons in the new dunj! You'll notice Axe's weapon form looks a bit different than before. Xin has redone his look to fit his personality and style. As a surfer, it was important for us to include water effects in his attacks, but the old "coral" design was a bit too fancy and unwieldy for his go-with-the-flow feel. His Swing ability causes you to dash forward towards the nearest group of enemies, which is great for mobility and high damage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/d5424db9013f8c8e3ebbcbcaa38226fb3c887d73.gif[/img]

Hammer also uses the power of the elements in her attacks. As a professional figure skater, she glides and spins with ease, even though she's a heavy hammer. You build up your energy together by attacking enemies normally, as each kill gives you a counter towards Death Spiral. Then unleash the spin to decimate everything in your path!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/bc3b5863fa9a210bc3856eb7bbf6d065a0af832c.gif[/img]

[h2]New Song Teaser[/h2]

Marskye and McQueen are releasing new tracks to go along with the DLC update. You can listen to a preview of one of the secretly-titled songs on Marskye's [url=https://soundcloud.com/marskye/bfd-dlc/s-O9cKdmm3HOO?utm_source=clipboard&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=social_sharing]Soundcloud[/url]:

[url=https://soundcloud.com/marskye/bfd-dlc/s-O9cKdmm3HOO?utm_source=clipboard&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=social_sharing][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/7c4d83c32e593b8589eeb7402a422646cf652b78.png[/img][/url]

I might be a little biased but we definitely have another dunj banger on our hands.

So that's all for now. We will have much more to discuss Very Soon and probably after The Future of 

Play Direct happening in June 🤐 Make sure to join [url=https://discord.com/invite/kitfoxgames]our Discord[/url] if you're not in it already. We will be doing another beta round for the DLC in the near future and will be asking for help in the Backers only channel! 

-Alexandra + Kitfox

notes.title: We won another big award, and we have news about the big update coming!
notes.content:
Hey sword smoochers,

It's Alexandra from Kitfox here with an update on how work has been coming along on the Boyfriend Dungeon DLC as well as some other exciting news. If you've signed up for our [url=https://www.kitfoxgames.com/sendy/kitfox-subscribe]Boyfriend Dungeon newsletter[/url], you have already received love letters from Axe, Hammer and the mysterious "H". I can't reveal who the mystery person is quite yet but I hear they are involved with developing new boss fight technology. Sounds like someone I don't want to mess with.  

But with all these mysteries afoot, it only makes sense to name the DLC update "Secret Weapons".

[h2]A Formal Event[/h2]

You are cordially invited to attend a special formal event and all the bae blades will be dressed in their finest threads. This will be a story event that takes place during the DLC and wielders will have a chance to take their partner along! Here is what Seven and Sawyer are planning to wear:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/bb993da4bab36376854cd5980331ae0156289d44.png[/img]

Pretty dapper if I do say so myself! 

[h2]Hub Encounters[/h2]

We are introducing a new DLC feature called "Hub Encounters" where you'll be able to interact with the bae blades while you're exploring the dunj. All of the weapons have been turned into adorable chibi forms. During these encounters you will see new scenes between weapons, most of whom have never interacted together before. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/87807f5cebd8f40384ee248f8df2e2c3de3cfb09.jpg[/img]

For example, Rowan and Sunder compare hair products. Valeria paints Pocket's portrait. And many more! They're little scenes you'll be able to find in the city between dating and dungeoning, including our dear new Leah and Jonah.

[h2]Game Developer's Choice Award[/h2]

Just last night, Boyfriend Dungeon was awarded the Game Developer's Choice Award for Social Impact. We are incredibly thankful to be honored among so many other amazing games. 

We also won a [url=https://thespawnies.com/#winners]Spawnie Award[/url] for Diversity, a show hosted by the lovely folks at Spawn On Me! 

We are nominated for a few more awards so stay tuned for those shows:
[b]
GLAAD Media Awards (April 2nd)[/b]

Outstanding Video Game

[b]Gayming Awards (April 25th)[/b]

Game of the Year

Gayming Magazine Readers' Award

Authentic Representation Award

Best LGBTQ Indie Game Award

[h2]Tiktok Live Q&A[/h2] 

I'll be Live on the [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@kitfoxgames]Kitfox Tiktok[/url] to hang out and chat with ya'll about all things Kitfox. Come with your questions about Boyfriend Dungeon, our other games or just to talk about a cool snack you've tried.  I'll be live March 24th (that's today!) at 3pm Eastern!

Looking forward to seeing ya'll!

Alexandra + Tanya and Kitfox Games

notes.title: Hammer, Axe and a new Dunj
notes.content:
We have a few updates to share as the Kitfox crew comes back from a much needed break. Ever since Boyfriend Dungeon released, people have been asking a few questions, I decided I'd get a few answers and share them with you. Here's the important bits:

1. Yes, Jonah is coming back to Verona Beach! He will be appearing in the DLC with...

2. Leah the Hammer! If you don't know her, she's kinda famous in Verona Beach because of figure skating. She is planning on coming home for the rest of the summer too!

3. There will be at least one more dunj coming!


[h2]Kitfox Reflects[/h2]

[previewyoutube=Q1R4b94RhgE;full][/previewyoutube]

Right before launch, we asked the Kitfox team a few questions about what it was like making the game and how they were feeling right before the surprise launch announcement. It's a must-watch for anyone looking for behind the scenes trivia and game dev info!

We can't say exactly when the DLC is coming or any other details for now, but we are still planning on providing regular updates on our progress! The fastest way to see our updates and to receive love letters from the weapons, sign up for our [url=https://www.kitfoxgames.com/sendy/kitfox-subscribe]newsletter[/url]!

With my AXE,

notes.title: Boyfriend Dungeon Patch Notes (Version 1.2.6266)
notes.content:
Hey there Sword Smoochers!

We have [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/674930/discussions/0/4758602630159870998/]a thread of known issues[/url] that might be helpful to anyone having trouble with the game.

Here are the patch notes to go along with today's update:

Version: 1.2.6266

[list]
[*]  Achievements should now be less prone to error and actually fire correctly if all equipment and gifts received.

[*]  The content warning translation has been updated to match the English improvements.

[*]  If you receive enough experience to reach level 51, the dungeon should now still function correctly.

[*]  If you get a Game Over during a date, reloading should now function correctly.

[*] If you previously received a Game Over during a date, that save file should also now function correctly.

[*]  (Uncertain) Crafting text should get cut off/masked/hidden less often now.

[*]  You can no longer get stuck in phase 3 of the final boss fight (or after the boss fight) by doing damage to people or enemies that were meant to be invulnerable.

[*]  Using the Phoenix Cap during the final boss and then losing should now give you a new Phoenix Cap during your re-attempt.
[/list]

We also wanted to let everyone know that we are officially on break starting tomorrow! It's been a busy last few weeks and after working on Boyfriend Dungeon for 4 years (wow!) the whole team is taking a much deserved rest. Expect communication to be a bit slower during this time. We hope to return refreshed and ready to start working on Hammer and Axe! Thank you to everyone who supported us on this journey to release and we hope you are enjoying the game so far!

-Alexandra, Tanya and the Kitfox team

notes.title: Boyfriend Dungeon will update with 'more accurate' content warning about stalking
notes.content: Boyfriend Dungeon is about dating and dungeon crawling with swords... that are also people. It had a surprise release on the 11th of August, and despite its goofy premise on the surface, its story explores some sensitive themes, as Rachel noted in her preview: "Dating for many women and queer folk in general is, unfortunately, a huge risk, and meeting in public, having a friend on hand, and checking out the place are just some of the many safety tips used when meeting dates the first time. For a game about smooching sharp weapons, it's great to see Boyfriend Dungeon acknowledge that.".. Read more.

notes.title: Gameplay, hidden rooms, and more dev updates!
notes.content:
Hi sword smoochers!

Been awhile since a dev update, huh? Thanks to anyone who dropped by the stream yesterday! It was a ton of fun playing through the demo with everyone.

We've uploaded the Twitch stream of the game on our Youtube page, which you can watch below.

[previewyoutube=rXaxmCDEUuc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Hidden Rooms[/h3]

So... there are secret rooms in the dungeons - filled with treasure, mysterious creatures, and maybe some fun stuff to look at. We've been working on those, and here's a little peek at a concept we have for it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/867b4f0a45c24b6ef3660d67c608ef89e663cc9b.jpg[/img]

I can't say too much about it because part of the surprise is discovering it for yourself of course. We're also polishing up the look of how the breakables and money look because... well, who doesn't want some extra cash to spend on dates with their bae blade?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/fa4809824d333ee368e315e6b6107272898c7429.png[/img]

There's some audio integration work going on as we add more and more voice actor lines in. :) Seven/Lasersaber will soon have some new abilities added to his arsenal too, which means he'll be even stronger to help protect you in the dungeon.

September is filled with more online game events, and we've got quite a few panels that we're doing online as part of PAX! You can see the full panel list here, in our [url=https://twitter.com/KitfoxGames/status/1301885761873227781]Twitter thread[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/7932748a5268fd86ac6a04c845dde47e965c41de.png[/img]

Whew, alright, that's it for me. See you around the internet!

notes.title: Beverage settings and an appearance at PAX East!
notes.content:
Hey sword smoochers!

A short update for February, because right now we're gearing up to head to PAX East! Woo! The Boyfriend Dungeon demo will be there of course, but so will our first ever playable demo for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/717560/Lucifer_Within_Us/]Lucifer Within Us[/url]. If you haven't heard, it's the other game we're developing (different team members than the one working on Boyfriend Dungeon though) that has you playing as a digital exorcist/detective. So basically, lots going on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/ad34fdeedf4ae7a325479eb011725d3ed2c76464.png[/img]

See you there? We'll be at Booth 27039. :)

[h3]Game Progress[/h3]
Since the last update, we've made progress on a little mini-game, which I can't tell you too much about. I know, secrets abound, but we can't spoil things! I can show you that there's now a "Beverage" option in the settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/4905b73f345763f02b1bd1d7fe209b90e2c99427.jpg[/img]

Why is there a "Beverage" setting? Well, before we had it so that bubble tea was your healing item in the game, but some people mentioned they wanted different drink options to heal them. So to better suit your tastes, we put in other drinks too. (But if you haven't tried bubble tea yet, I recommend taking a stab at it!)

There has also been some nice aesthetic and gameplay improvements to the dungeons in the game. Before, a lot of the dungeon generations would lead to dead-ends, which meant you had to backtrack quite a bit. So we improved it so it loops a bit better, and is more fun to explore. :) We've been playtesting it more and more to add fixes and find more bugs, and it's really chugging along well!

Okay, back to work for meeee. If you ever want these updates in a cool love letter format from the bae blades, don't forget we have a [url=http://www.kitfoxgames.com/sendy/kitfox-subscribe]newsletter[/url]!

xoxo,

Victoria

notes.title: PAX West, Crafting, and Setting the Mood~
notes.content:
Hey sword smoochers!

Hope you’ve been *thirsty* for some new updates on the dateable blades. Lots of stuff has been happening behind-the-blacksmith, so here’s a lil’ peek at it for you.

[h1]Moods[/h1]
We’ve integrated fancy reactions for the weapons. When you give them certain gifts or make certain choices, you'll know a little bit of how they feel, which they tell me is kinda embarrassing, but whatever.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259798/0f631498fa559053aae2a3dff82058735bd90432.gif[/img]

They won’t STOP liking you if you make an iffy choice, but maybe it's better to think about what you're saying or giving someone, before you say or give it.


[h1]Build Up Your Love[/h1]
What's a sword without a wielder? And what's a game without crafting? That's right, we've been working on the crafting system.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259798/7d9247b27cdb24229a9c0fc57a9349ccef7aa2d8.jpg[/img]

As you slay monsters in the dunj, they'll drop various materials you can gather. Recipes will also hidden away in treasure vaults that you'll find as you explore the map. With these things you'll be able to craft a variety of items - gifts, clothes, and magazines. Each recipe makes a particular item, but you won't know exactly what it is until you've finished making it! Exciting.

Keep in mind that different blades will like different gifts - for example, Valeria the Dagger won't be too pleased with a very "cutesie" gift. (Doesn't she know it's the thought that counts?)

[h1]PAX West & Demo[/h1]
We'll be at this year's PAX West with our latest Boyfriend Dungeon demo, which allows you to date Sunder, Valeria, Seven, AND Isaac! If you were there last year, this will be a new demo, so it's worth swinging by Booth 6120 to get some additional smooching. 

Plus you'll be able to buy some nice merch, like the Boyfriend Dungeon pins and our cool t-shirt.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259798/c0e5090994566fae8abdf7cf7ab8449eade7f72e.png[/img]

Hope to see you there! If not, then I will of course see you around the internetsphere. Obligatory plug to [url=http://www.twitter.com/kitfoxgames]Twitter[/url]. And [url=https://discord.gg/kitfoxgames]Discord[/url].

Cheers,
Victoria

notes.title: Dunj Updates and Isaac’s New Weapon Name 🗡️
notes.content:
Hi Sword Smoochers~

Ah, spring. The season of allergies and love. And updates, apparently!

[h1]Dunj Updates[/h1]
Okay, so let’s get right to the dev updates. The Nightclub Dunj is being fitted with its new monsters and attacks, and for the past few weeks we’ve been working on a BRAND NEW demo. Our previous one (which you’ve played if you’ve been at PAX or whatever convention Boyfriend Dungeon has been at) was nice, but outdated for about… a whole year now. The dunj environments have been improved, the combat is smoother, and the various bugs have been fixed.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259798/02331c93537b8fb49ad7fc0ab1549d87d8a49f5f.png[/img]
The new demo also features dates with Isaac. Before you could only fight with Sunder and Valeria, but now a third will be added to the mix. Sunder is only a little disappointed he isn’t the center of attention, but he needs to learn to SHARE *cough cough*.

[h1]Isaac Updates + His Letter
[/h1]
By the way. We got a lot of comments that Isaac wasn’t REALLY an Épée judging from the shape and uh, you know what? You’re right! From now on he will be Isaac, the Estoque. Nothing else has changed -- he’s still the suave financier you know and love.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259798/c19053c75bedd9f832502fd37181a719b1c28bd9.png[/img]
Plus we even gave him a whole new outfit for when he’s busy at fencing practice!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259798/c8b4502db0b156692d848f9f3a6f86042e295000.png[/img]
Ah, he is so dapper. If you want to read the latest newsletter IN HIS VOICE, [url=https://mailchi.mp/kitfoxgames/isaac-new-look-newsletter]you can read it here[/url]! 

[h1]Conventions[/h1]
So where can you play this brand new demo, you ask? Well, if you go to E3, we’ll be on the showfloor with it! From May 28 - 30, we’ll also be in London for Casual Connect Europe, where we’re a finalist for the Indie Prize! Aaahhh fingers crossed. You can play the old demo there and say hi to our programmer Marcelo.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259798/1c503b5c9882f25a4b7290091d3fe3ca3be2675a.png[/img]

This isn’t related to Boyfriend Dungeon buuuuuuut if you’ve been paying attention to our channels, you’ll know we’ve been hinting that half of our team has been working on something else for the past year or so. All of that will be revealed online at the [url=https://twitter.com/KitfoxGames/status/1131230236908097538]Kinda Funny Games Showcase[/url]. Mark your calendars for June 10th @ 4:30 PST, at [url=youtube.com/kindafunnygames]youtube.com/kindafunnygames[/url] to see what the other half of the team has been up to!

We can give you a little hint. It’s dark, and ~mysterious~...

In the meantime, we’ll see you around on [url=https://discord.gg/kitfoxgames]Discord[/url] and [url=http://www.twitter.com/kitfoxgames]Twitter,[/url] or our [url=http://eepurl.com/RL5cP]newsletter[/url].

See you next time,

Victoria and the Kitfox Team
